g.text: Rural KP earners' average pay climbs with age, peaking at Rs 352,522 at ages 50-54
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files. Sample: earners aged 15-64 with earnings > 0 in rural Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) (n = 3,396).
Dots: individual earners (jittered, transparent; 13 outside the axis range not shown).
Red markers: household-weighted (hhweight) mean of each 5-year band.
Hollow markers = bands with fewer than 30 earners (thin bands); there are none in this sample.
